content.text: The Atlanta Braves (1-0) made a winner of new manager Walt Weiss in his debut and look to clinch a season-opening series win when they face the Kansas City Royals (0-1) at Truist Park in suburban Atlanta on Friday night.ATLANTA, GEORGIA - MARCH 27: Michael Harris II #23 of the Atlanta Braves reacts as he rounds first base after hitting a two-run homer against the Kan...How to Watch Royals vs BravesDate: Saturday, March 28, 2026Time: 7:00 PM ETChannel: MLB.TV - Kansas City Royals, FOX (regional coverage)Stream: Fubo (TRY FOR FREE)Chris Sale worked six scoreless innings, allowing three hits and striking out six, to lead Atlanta to a 6-0 victory on opening night Friday. Michael Harris II hit a two-run homer in the fourth inning after Ozzie Albies got the Braves on the board with a solo shot in the first and Drake Baldwin went deep in the third. Newcomer Mauricio Dubon added a two-run double in the seventh as well.Cole Ragans surrendered four runs in four innings while taking the loss for the Royals, striking out five and walking four and departing after throwing 90 pitches. Bobby Witt Jr. had two of Kansas City’s five hits, all singles, in the loss.The Braves give the ball to right-hander Reynaldo Lopez on Saturday night. Lopez was limited to one start and five innings last season before undergoing surgery on his shoulder after earning an All-Star berth in his first season in Atlanta in 2024. Veteran right-hander Michael Wacha gets the call for Kansas City.
